commentary.text: 90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+7' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Nantes.
90+4' After what seems an eternity, referee Benoit Millot decides there was a foul after using VAR to review the goal! NO GOAL, play to continue.
90+4' Nantes score a goal, but referee Benoit Millot has now indicated he wants to check if the goal can stand using VAR!
90+3' Moses Simon (Nantes) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Yellow card. Martin Satriano (Brest) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
86' Eric Roy has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Julien Le Cardinal (Brest) replacing Jeremy Le Douaron.
86' Benoit Millot shows the yellow card to Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) for a heavy challenge.
85' Nantes can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

84' A neat pass finds Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) in space. He needs no second invitation to shoot and hits a piledriver from distance towards the right side of the goal, but Alban Lafont denies him with a good save.
83' It is time for a substitution. Jaouen Hadjam (Nantes) is on for Quentin Merlin.
82' One of the Nantes players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul.
82' A player from Brest takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
82' Pedro Chirivella (Nantes) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
80' A player from Brest brings down an opponent and commits a foul.
78' Alban Lafont (Nantes) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Benoit Millot's book.
78' Martin Satriano (Brest) has a great chance inside the box following a rebound off a defender, but somehow he gets underneath the ball and it flies high over the bar.
73' One of the Brest players commits a holding foul and the referee reaches for his whistle.
72' Substitution. Moussa Sissoko walks off the pitch and Matthis Abline (Nantes) comes on as a substitute.
71' Martin Satriano (Brest) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Steve Mounie.
71' The substitution is prepared. Jonas Martin (Brest) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Hugo Magnetti.
70' The corner is swung in but Nantes can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
70' The linesman referee is pointing towards the corner flag. It will be a corner kick.
68' Moses Simon (Nantes) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
68' Nantes concede a free kick after one of their players holds onto an opposition player. Brest are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
66' Moses Simon (Nantes) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
65' Eric Roy decides to make a substitution. Mahdi Camara will be replaced by Kamory Doumbia (Brest).
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Romain Del Castillo leaves the pitch and Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) comes on.
64' Moses Simon (Nantes) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Marco Bizot.
63' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Nantes comes to nothing.
62' A brilliant cross into the box finds Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes), who directs his header to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes an astonishing save.
62' Handball! A player from Nantes handled the ball.
61' Quentin Merlin (Nantes) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
58' That will be all from Douglas Augusto (Nantes) who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Marquinhos.
58' We are about to witness a subsitution. Fabien Centonze (Nantes) for Jean-Charles Castelletto.
57' 0 - 2 Goal! Steve Mounie (Brest) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 0:2.
57' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) will take the corner.
55' Moses Simon (Nantes) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
53' Quentin Merlin (Nantes) is first to react to a loose pass inside the box, but slices his shot just wide of the right post.
49' 0 - 1 Goal! Romain Del Castillo tees up Hugo Magnetti (Brest) on the edge of the box and he fires the ball into the bottom left corner. 0:1.
49' Moses Simon (Nantes) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
48' Here is a change. Douglas Augusto is going off and Jocelyn Gourvennec gives the last tactical orders to Marquinhos (Nantes).
48' A player from Brest commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
46' The whistle blows and Benoit Millot starts the second half.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' Moses Simon (Nantes) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball miles wide of the right post. Nice run, but poor finish!
43' Nantes concede a free kick following a bad challenge.
41' Nicolas Pallois (Nantes) escapes the opposition's pressure by passing the ball on the ground.
40' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) heads on.
39' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) picks up a precise pass deep inside the box, but his strike is saved by the keeper.
35' A pass from Florent Mollet (Nantes) is intercepted by Marco Bizot and the move breaks down.
34' One of the Nantes players commits a holding foul and the referee reaches for his whistle.
33' One of the Nantes players commits a holding foul and the referee reaches for his whistle.

31' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the top right corner. Marco Bizot pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
30' Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
28' Benoit Millot shows a yellow card to Mahdi Camara (Brest) for a tough tackle.
27' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
25' A pass by Moussa Sissoko (Nantes) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
24' Florent Mollet (Nantes) picks up a rebound in space and tries his luck from long range, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
21' Jean-Charles Castelletto (Nantes) is having a lively performance. He is causing problems and wanting the ball at every opportunity.
20' Bradley Locko (Brest) and Lilian Brassier matched up again to find some space for an unmarked teammate.
19' Moses Simon (Nantes) is quick to pick up the loose pass from Quentin Merlin. He tries his luck from mid-range, but it goes well wide of the right post.
17' Florent Mollet (Nantes) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
14' Bradley Locko (Brest) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
9' One of the Nantes players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul.
8' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
7' Martin Satriano (Brest) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
5' Brendan Chardonnet (Brest) connects with the corner but his looping header goes well over.
5' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) will deliver the corner kick.
3' One of the Brest players was holding his opponent and the referee doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
2' Lilian Brassier (Brest) and Brendan Chardonnet combine well with a quick one-two and their attacking move continues.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Nantes will kick the game off.
Benoit Millot was nominated as the referee for this game.
